name: Morphine methylbromide
summary: Morphine methylbromide (morphine methobromide, morphine bromomethylate, morphosan) a derivative of morphine. It is a narcotic opioid listed as a Schedule I controlled substance with an ACSCN of 9305 and a 2014 aggregate national production quota of 5 grams. It is a quaternary ammonium salt formed by reaction of morphine with methyl bromide.
